3240-6277-6462-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

401-3944-4063-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-4063-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-4446.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1722-2034-3583-4446.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

678-5865-8227.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
678-5865-8227.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2137-4642-7297.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-7297.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

5254-5256-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-5256-6627.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

6258-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

1445-4871-6351-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6351-8095.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-864-2921-3125-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2921-3125-5477.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

301-1453-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
3967-6972-7607.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2292-4871-6705.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2511-2533-4681-6913.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Chameleon.
Repeat.

1978-5116-7170.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Living Brain.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1322-3490-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1322-3490-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

6913-7073.easyPrerequisites:
Pramikon and Chameleon are naming different directions.
You have at least two opponents.
6913-7073.description: Because Chameleon and Pramikon disagree on the direction in which players can attack, players are unable to attack at all so long as there are three or more players.
6913-7073.notes: Here is a relevant ruling from Pramikon relating to this lock: "If two Pramikons on the battlefield disagree on which direction three or more players must attack, players can't attack at all. (2019-08-23)"

1482-4195-4574-5849.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1074-1379-1651-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and King Macar, targeting King Macar.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating a Gold token.
Repeat.
1074-1379-1651-5640.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired whenever an opponent controls a creature.

804-2232-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
804-2232-6749.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Sakashima the Impostor from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sakashima the Impostor leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Sakashima the Impostor from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

81-1491-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

1170-4636-5089.notablePrerequisites: You are able to make eight {E} each turn.
1170-4636-5089.description:
Activate Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Gonti's Aether Heart from exile to your hand.
Cast Gonti's Aether Heart by paying {6}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant

678-891-4050-4284-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Clone.
678-891-4050-4284-5214.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Clone, adding one mana of any color.
When Clone dies, Enduring Renewal and Next of Kin trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Clone to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Next of Kin trigger, putting Clone from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Clone.
Repeat.

575-3565-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one blue card in hand.
575-3565-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dragon's Eye Savants.
When Dragon's Eye Savants dies, Yedora triggers, returning Dragon's Eye Savants to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dragon's Eye Savants's morph ability by revealing a blue card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2645-3151.notablePrerequisites: Elvish Archdruid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least five Elves.
2645-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3151.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

3433-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hornet Queen, adding {1}.
Hornet Queen dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Hornet Queen from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Insects, adding {3}.
Repeat.

579-2816-4360.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Greenweaver Druid.
Greenweaver Druid does not have summoning sickness.
579-2816-4360.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Greenweaver Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

401-4659-5004.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
401-4659-5004.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and Decaying Soil.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Cathodion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat.
